C-GRACE-EXECUTABLE-ASSERTIONS-240.Summary: Prepare exact project dependencies and an approved Chromium runtime before GRACE executes project and Playwright assertions.
C-GRACE-EXECUTABLE-ASSERTIONS-240.Problem: GRACE contract jobs install the pinned GRACE CLI but execute approved MustPassCommand entries in a clean runner without project dependencies. A valid Playwright assertion therefore fails while loading playwright.config.mjs because @playwright/test is absent, before any product test is run.

Goals.Goal: Install dependencies exactly from package-lock.json before baseline or final executable assertions.
Detect Playwright commands only inside the selected approved change plan and install Chromium only when such an assertion is present.
Keep dependency, browser and assertion failures fail-closed and observable.
Unblock the approved browser evidence in issue 235 without modifying its approved plan or widening its observed write scope.

Constraints.Constraint: GRACE CLI and Bun remain pinned engineering tools and do not enter the application runtime or offline bundle.
npm ci must use the committed lockfile, ignore lifecycle scripts and must not mutate repository files.
Chromium preparation occurs only for a selected baseline or final change whose Command entries request Playwright.
No product behavior, database schema, release version, package version or user interface changes are included.
A missing lockfile, failed dependency installation, failed browser installation or failed assertion remains a blocking error.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Install Playwright or Chromium into the production application, Debian/Astra bundle or target host.
Change project test commands or make browser assertions optional.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Baseline and final GRACE change gates run npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund before executable assertions.
A deterministic helper reads only the selected active plan Command entries and reports whether Playwright is required.
The workflow installs Chromium with Playwright system dependencies only when the helper reports an approved browser assertion.
A plan without a Playwright command does not trigger Chromium installation.
Regression tests cover direct Playwright commands, npm browser scripts, unrelated prose, XML entities, invalid change ids and GitHub output.
GRACE current, baseline, final, project CI and post-merge CI succeed on exact immutable heads before the change is archived as applied.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact branch head prepares locked project dependencies, conditionally installs Chromium, and then executes selected assertions without weakening their result.

Assumptions.Assumption: package-lock.json remains the authoritative development dependency lockfile.
Approved change plans keep executable commands inside Command elements.
GitHub-hosted Ubuntu permits the same Playwright Chromium installation already used by the project browser job.
